name: Deception
source:
A school with a horrible system just like any other. Except there are dangerous entities called 'deformats' that roam around the halls taking over peoples' minds and bodies.

Defend your friends and execute the deformat and maybe you'll live.

[From [url=https://kydiot.itch.io/deception]Itch.io[/url]]
